title: Adherence Packaging and Medication Review Settings Annex — Auto Refill & Medication Sync
content:
Multi-dose adherence packs, the extra preparation they need, the days one set of cards covers, the dose-change cut-off, whether controlled substances may go in the packs, and whether a pharmacist reviews the whole medication list every cycle are set per Auto Refill & Medication Sync program in this annex.

| Program | Doses dispensed in multi-dose adherence packs | Extra calendar days of lead time to prepare packs | Days covered by one set of adherence cards | Calendar days before processing by which a dose change must be on file to be in the next packs | Controlled substances may be placed in packs | Pharmacist reviews the whole medication list each cycle |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Auto Refill 30-Day | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | No | No |
| Kestrel Auto Refill 90-Day | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | No | No |
| Kestrel Med Sync Monthly | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | No | Yes |
| Kestrel Med Sync 90-Day | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | No | Yes |
| Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging | Yes | 3 | 28 | 5 | No | Yes |
| Kestrel Home Delivery Auto Refill | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | No | No |

## Annex notes

1. Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging is the only program that dispenses in adherence packs; its packs need 3 extra calendar days of preparation, one set of cards covers 28 days, and a dose change must be on file 5 calendar days before processing to reach the next packs.
2. Where no packaging applies, the card-days figure is 0, as are the preparation and dose-change figures.
3. No program allows controlled substances in adherence packs.
4. A per-cycle pharmacist review of the whole medication list applies in the three Med Sync programs (Kestrel Med Sync Monthly, Kestrel Med Sync 90-Day, Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging) and not in the three Auto Refill programs.
